Name: accordion
Title: Accordion
Summary: Native disclosure with an accessible summary.

Props.Name: name
Props.Description: Nonempty name groups details exclusively within the same tree.

Props.Name: open
Props.Description: Whether the disclosure is initially open.

Slots.Name: summary
Slots.Description: Accessible disclosure label; avoid nested interactive controls.

Requirements: The summary is the first child. Its native activation opens or closes the details.
Read root.open on toggle to synchronize adapter state; slot scope is an initial snapshot in the native factory.
For exclusive groups use the same nonempty name in the same tree, not necessarily siblings. Do not nest members of the same named group.

Events.Name: toggle
Events.Description: Native notification; adapters own application state updates.

Styling: Choose spacing, typography, and focus indicators in the consuming design system. Preserve native keyboard and disabled semantics.

Name: alert-dialog
Title: Alert Dialog
Summary: Native modal dialog with declarative open and close buttons.

Props.Name: descriptionId
Props.Description: Unique ID on the slotted alert description.

Slots.Name: content
Slots.Description: Dialog contents; for alert-dialog assign descriptionId to its descriptive element.

Requirements: IDs must be unique within the document. Opening uses command="show-modal"; setting open alone is nonmodal.
On browsers without invoker commands, the adapter must call dialog.showModal() and dialog.close() from button handlers. Feature-detect command support.

Choose suitable initial focus, verify focus restoration, and handle cancel/close. For alert dialogs, connect the required descriptionId to descriptive content and choose a least-destructive initial action.
Action outcomes, controlled state, and dismissal policy belong to the adapter.

Events.Name: close
Events.Description: Native notification; adapters own application state updates.

Events.Name: cancel
Events.Description: Native notification; adapters own application state updates.

Styling: Set size, backdrop, spacing, and responsive placement in consuming CSS. For drawers position the dialog at an edge. Preserve visible focus and reduced-motion preferences.

Name: autocomplete
Title: Autocomplete
Summary: Native datalist suggestions.

Slots.Name: label
Slots.Description: Accessible label as noninteractive phrasing content.

Slots.Name: options
Slots.Description: Native option content. A select may receive an optgroup of options; converters may emit multiple options.

Requirements: The control is associated with its enclosing label. Supply valid option elements.
Datalist is a basic suggestion UI; it does not provide rich controlled combobox behavior, async filtering, or a fixed option-only value.
The native factory takes one HTMLElement per slot; framework converters can map the slot to their own multi-node content representation.

Name: checkbox
Title: Checkbox

Props.Description: Requires a value or checked state for submission.
